name: 51742-sharegpt-35b-dflash-2gpu
hardware: 2x H100 80GB HBM3 of one a3 node, one node, NVLink between the pair.
parallelism: TP=2, PP=1, DP=1, EP off, V1 engine core, one in-process vLLM engine. TP=2 is forced by capacity, not chosen; do not substitute pipeline parallelism.
architecture: Target: hybrid sparse-MoE decoder, 40 layers (30 linear/gated-delta attention, 10 full attention), 256 experts with top-8 routing, bf16, 35.95B parameters = 71.9 GB; the checkpoint's vision tower is untouched by this text-only workload. Drafter: 6 layers, 0.386B parameters = 0.77 GB, block-diffusion, 8 proposed tokens per step.
load_profile: concurrent (CLOSED loop), 1 stream, 200 requests of warmup by COUNT, bounded at 260 requests with a 1800 s safety cap, so 60 requests are measured. One stream is the declared operating point; do not sweep it.
workload: guidellm `json_file` over configs/data/sharegpt-1160-out300-qwen3.6-35b-a3b.jsonl, single turn, plain request format (no chat template), 300 output tokens on EVERY row (max_tokens=300 plus ignore_eos, so token counts are identical run to run). Prompts are ShareGPT first turns, mean 242 tokens over the pool, p50 113, p90 695, max 1017. Sampling is left at the backend default: do not pin temperature to 0.
purpose: A 35-billion-parameter mixture-of-experts chat assistant with a draft model, answering single-turn prompts one at a time on two GPUs.
launch:
model: Qwen/Qwen3.6-35B-A3B

# KEEP ON ONE LINE -- an object value is read only as single-line JSON; re-flowing it drops the key.
speculative-config: {"model": "z-lab/Qwen3.6-35B-A3B-DFlash", "method": "dflash", "num_speculative_tokens": 8}

# Forced by capacity: 71.9 GB of bf16 weights leaves no usable KV room on one 80 GB H100.
# Pipeline parallelism must not be substituted for it.
tensor-parallel-size: 2

max-num-seqs: 16
enable-prefix-caching: false

# The checkpoint's own default is 262144; the longest request here is 1324 tokens.
max-model-len: 8192

# Engine defaults, written out so they cannot drift.
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90
dtype: bfloat16
